CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible.
   B. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Jeremiah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Jeremiah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prophet Jeremiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Prophet Jeremiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Prophet Jeremiah to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

5. Which response best shows understanding of Principles of Good Stewardship? (1 mark)

   C. Use Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation has no place in daily life.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

9. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Judges? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Judges has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Judges.

----
